bit string types.name: source port
bit string types.description: port of the sending process, or zero if not used.

bit string types.name: destination port
bit string types.description: port to which a reply should be addressed.

bit string types.name: length
bit string types.description: total length of the segment (minimum value is 8).

fields.name: source port
fields.description: port of the sending process. may be assumed to be the port to which a reply should be addressed. if not used, a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: port to which a reply should be addressed.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: one's complement sum checksum. calculated over pseudo header information and data.
